theorems.name: Submission.frt_lipschitz_graph_hausdorff_compare
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (S : Set (Euclidean N)), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ S, ∀ z ∈ S, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ r : ℝ, (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((Grassmannian.project P '' S) ∩ closedBall (Grassmannian.project P x) (r / Real.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2))) ≤ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) (S ∩ closedBall x r) ∧ (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) (S ∩ closedBall x r) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2)) ^ n * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ((Grassmannian.project P '' S) ∩ closedBall (Grassmannian.project P x) r)) ∧ ∀ Y : Set (Euclidean N), (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) (S ∩ Grassmannian.project P ⁻¹' Y) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (1 + L ^ 2)) ^ n * (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) Y
